changelog.entry: New: the legacy bonus is now a small chip whose tooltip names where it came from (your last forest's standing value) and how close it is to the +25% cap. If the forest kept growing while the tab was hidden you get a 'While you were away' chip saying what changed. The Session Summary has a Request history table: every community request you answered, your choice, and how that plot's value has changed since, sortable and filterable. Plots can now carry a short note (up to 20 characters): type it in the Plot note box under the plot readout, or right-click or long-press a plot to jump to the box; a noted plot shows a dot and its note in the tooltip. The Session Summary also has Lifetime statistics: sessions finished, plots cleared and replanted, time in the forest and your average standing value by difficulty, kept on this device. A new Scenario picker starts you in a ready-made forest: Clear-cut Valley (60% of plots bare), Fragmented Farmland (a checkerboard) or Old-Growth Remnant (only one intact core). Each scenario keeps its own best standing value. The Session Summary has a Download forest card button: a 1200 by 630 picture of your final grid with your playstyle badge and three headline numbers, drawn in code, each plot also marked with a letter so it reads without colour. A new opt-in setting, Coach hints, adds short notes to the Session Summary that read your forest (a plot cleared three times, soil below 60%, bare plots with nothing replanted, low community relations); they never block play and can be dismissed.

New: the Session Summary has a Copy result button that copies one line, such as Canopy, 41.2 standing forest value, with your harvested income, biodiversity and plots still standing. Every achievement you have earned now has a Share button that copies a line you can paste anywhere, with the share of players who have it when that figure is available. The How to Play and Info panels link to the new Credits page.

New: a Pause, 1x, 2x and 4x control sits under the toolbar (Space pauses or resumes, [ and ] change the speed). Faster only means the game ticks more often, never that anything is skipped, and nothing at all happens while it is paused. New: a setting, on by default, pauses the game while this browser tab is hidden and tells you when you come back; switch it off in Settings if you want it to keep running in the background.

New: a Levels screen (the Levels button, or the Menu on Desktop) with 15 levels. Every fifth one is a mode or a new mechanic: Poacher Patrol (click the plot, or press P, before a poacher strikes), Storm Front (replant the gaps before each front sweeps two rows) and The Spirit's Walk (a forest spirit sets six small tasks and narrates them); the four challenge runs are levels too. Your best result for each level is kept. New: the Seed Vault, a skill tree you spend seed points in (1 point for each level completed, forest tier reached and every 4 achievements): growth and soil perks, plus idle ranger crews that tend, catch seedlings and replant for you. Perks rest during challenge runs. In Settings, Level effects turns off the modes' animations.

New: four challenge runs (Pacifist, Scorched Start, Sprint, No-Highland) each with a badge and a fastest-finish record; a Ranger contracts board with three open contracts, income rewards, ranks and ten collectable stamps; a forecast line showing the next two seasons and the next rain or drought; a Request pace choice (relaxed, normal, frequent); a two-line plot card with age, biodiversity rate and clear count; C and R keys to clear or replant the selected plot, a thicker gold cursor ring and a screen-reader announcer; and in Settings, high-contrast plots (B / G / M / R letters and bold borders), a soil quality overlay and a number format choice.

Fixes from player reports: on a phone the action buttons now sit in one compact row at the bottom (a ... button unfolds the tend hint and forest name) so the forest grid is no longer buried under pinned panels; the arrow keys move between plots again and keep their place from one second to the next; Reset Session now opens a clear Cancel / Reset session dialog (Esc cancels) instead of needing a quick second press; and on the Desktop layout the side column fits without scrolling, with the forest summary, the forest picture and Name your forest moved into the Menu.

Canopy now has a Desktop layout for wide windows with a mouse: the forest grid fills the window, the actions for the selected plot and any community request sit beside it, income, standing value, biodiversity and relations are chips along the top, and the Almanac, achievements, session summary, settings and the Highland and Wetland regions open as windows (press Esc for the menu). Same saves as the Classic layout, and you can switch from the menu or the opening screen.

Canopy gamified batch: golden seedlings to catch (or press G), a Tend action (T) with a cooldown, a hidden Heart Tree for the curious, name your forest and nickname an adopted plot, a short Undo after Clear (not in Forest ranger), rare wildlife with conditions (a ghost stag at late-autumn dusk, a wary fox), forest tiers (Seedling, Grove, Woodland, Old-Growth) with three new achievements, rain and drought on the season indicator, chain-bloom leaf ripples, a Forest Almanac, and a Perfect Season flame streak.

Light theme polish: Canopy now has a proper light look. The readouts, plot tile edges, selection and flood outlines, info buttons, switch lights and session graphs were re-coloured so they stay readable on a light page, and the Light/Dark control moved from a floating pill into the Settings panel. The dark theme looks exactly as before and no save or game number changed.

In the real world: a collapsible note beside the forest pairs what you just did with one sourced real example. Clearing shows global forest-loss figures, replanting the Atlantic Forest Restoration Pact, wildlife how regrown forest recovers, a mature plot forest carbon sinks, and a community request Nepal's community forestry or Africa's Great Green Wall. Each names its source and links to it, and it never changes your forest or save (W2).

Story mode: the Wren Hollow story. A short chapter is added to a collapsible Story panel for each achievement you earn, from the first cut to a closed canopy. It is optional, follows the existing Story on/off pill, and never changes your save (W1).

Wetland Forest: a third region unlocked at 5000 standing forest value. It grows 25% faster than the main forest, but a flood sweeps it every 50 ticks — young plots lose 30% of their value, mature ones 10%, replanting plots get silted back — with a 10-tick warning so you can harvest ahead of the water (B1).
Example playthrough: a narrated, worked-out example of a strong preserve/clear balance, with every number calculated from the game's own settings (B29).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).

Session Summary is now print-friendly: printing the page (e.g. Ctrl/Cmd+P) while it's open hides the site chrome and renders the summary in clean dark-on-white, instead of the site's usual dark theme and UI.
Highland Grove now has its own distinct rates: soil degrades 50% faster per clear and standing value compounds 25% slower than the main forest, reflecting a harsher high-altitude ecosystem.

Round-2 pass, remaining items: reforestation partner (faster replant recovery for a permanent value share), a legacy forest bonus carried into the next session from the last one's standing value, a seasonal growth cycle, and the shared personal-best badge flash (also rolled out to Tide and Thaw).

Round-2 pass: Small 4x4 grid, Forest ranger difficulty, forest history + wildlife log, playstyle badge, report-card graphs, veteran and adopted plots, specialist plots, replanting grants, Highland unlock progress bar, biodiversity rate, and an opt-in community comparison.
Onboarding-tooltip coverage audit completed — legend and stakeholder info-icons plus per-plot tooltips already cover every non-obvious mechanic, no gap found.
Settings panel added: text size (A-/A/A+) and a reduce-motion toggle, both persisted per-browser.
Space theme visual pass: starfield background, glass panels, gradient buttons, gradient-glow title.
Code-quality audit: fixed a create_proxy memory leak in the plot-grid render loop and a stale stakeholder-request bug that could hand out a free relations bonus.
Pass 3 (fun/teaching balance): re-paced stakeholder tension and the biodiversity payoff closer together to close an early idle stretch.
Info Page added with curated real-world sources on deforestation and carbon sinks.
Pass 2: biodiversity sub-meter (wildlife icons on mature plots) and stakeholder-tension decision events.
Pass 1: continuous plot-maturity color gradient, recovery-milestone flash, and a real-world context blurb.
All 7 milestones complete: plot grid, passive value accrual, clearing + soil degradation, replant recovery, comparison scoring, feedback prompt, visual pass + hub integration.
